editorial.description_en: Paper that has yellowed at the edges. Warmer and a step darker than thin paper, and the point where this group stops reading as white.
editorial.description_ja: 時間がたって黄ばんだ紙のような色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.833, C 0.021, h 74.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 古 (furu, old) + 紙 (kami, paper), rendaku to -gami. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Aged Paper" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 古紙. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — kawaki-suna at ΔE00 2.7, sekkai-kabe at ΔE00 5.1, asa-nuno at ΔE00 6.0. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.021 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
